import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

SHAPES = [
    (1024,),
    (32, 1024),
    (8, 128, 512),
    (4, 8, 64, 256),
]

def gen_inputs(axes, device):
    idx = axes.get("shape_id", 0)
    shape = SHAPES[idx]
    return {"input_0": torch.randn(shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)}

def run(input_0, dim, output):
    result = F.softmax(input_0, dim=dim)
    output.copy_(result)
